metadata.title: Claude, Auto Updater.
metadata.purpose: Answer whether a Claude Skill named auto-updater runs on logic baked into the model, or on a plain file Claude reads and follows -- using the general mechanism every Claude Skill shares (a folder, one SKILL.md, steps read in order) since the source never states auto-updater's specific steps. Lands the carry-out that the SKILL.md is the whole program: reliable inside what's written, blind past its edge.
metadata.anchor_pair: B01 -> B03 (the SKILL.md card with its five numbered steps, run twice with identical results, then a case outside the file with nothing to match)

beats.narration_text: Someone assumes Claude's auto-updater logic is baked into the model itself — some hidden capability. It isn't. It's baked into a file: SKILL.md. So — is the logic baked into the file?

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'Claude's auto-updater — is the logic baked into the model?', hesitates on 'model', corrects to 'file', lands the real question

props.text:
Claude's auto-updater —
is the logic baked
into the model?

beats.note: B00 is Remotion (BrutalistHesitantWriter) per hai-simple SKILL.md WRITER LAW. TIMING LAW: 20-35 word narration + lead_silence_s 0.8 to give the typing a >=9s window; verify media/B00.mp4 >= 8s and that the correction ('model' -> 'file') is visible on a late frame.

beats.narration_text: A Claude Skill is just a folder Claude reads before it acts. This one is named auto-updater, and everything it knows lives in one file: SKILL.md — plain sentences, not code. Open it, and you'd see something like five numbered steps, top to bottom. Claude reads that file, then follows it. The file is the whole program.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR — a SKILL.md card opening, five numbered steps typing themselves in top to bottom

production_viz.label: THE ANCHOR — SKILL.md, five steps
production_viz.mechanic: A folder icon labelled 'auto-updater' opens to reveal a single file card, 'SKILL.md', in the center. The card expands; five numbered lines type themselves in top to bottom, 'Step 1' through 'Step 5', plain sentence style, no code font. THIS EXACT CARD RETURNS AT B03.

beats.narration_text: It can look like Claude is reasoning out what to do on its own — that's the guess most people make. It isn't, here. Claude works straight down the Steps section, one step after another, and only branches where a step actually says to. Delete step three from that file, and step three simply doesn't happen. Nothing hidden fills the gap.

shot.new_visual_element: A linear pipeline of boxes, step 1 through done; step 3 struck out and skipped, nothing filling the gap

production_viz.label: Linear, no hidden fallback
production_viz.mechanic: A left-to-right pipeline: READ REQUEST -> STEP 1 -> STEP 2 -> STEP 3 -> STEP 4 -> DONE, arrows flowing forward only, one small diamond decision box under a step labelled 'only if the step says so'. Then STEP 3 fades to a dashed outline and strikes through; the arrow passes straight over the empty space to STEP 4 -- nothing appears in the gap.

beats.narration_text: Go back to that same SKILL.md, the one with its steps listed top to bottom. Run auto-updater on the same input twice, and you get the same steps and the same result both times — that holds for as long as the input stays inside what the file describes. Step outside it, into a case the file never anticipated, and Claude has nothing written there to fall back on.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR RETURNS — the same SKILL.md card, run twice side by side with identical checkmarks; then a case outside the file, a blank with nothing to match

production_viz.label: THE ANCHOR RETURNS — same file, same result, then the edge
production_viz.mechanic: THE B01 SKILL.md CARD RETURNS, identical, its five numbered steps visible. It duplicates into two side-by-side copies, each fed the same 'input' token; both run their five steps in lockstep and land on identical green checkmarks at the end. Then a third token appears, shaped differently, outside the pattern -- it approaches the same five steps and stops short of step 1 with a small blank card: no matching step, nothing happens.

beats.narration_text: A Skill's SKILL.md is the whole program. Claude follows it exactly — reliable inside what's written, blind past its edge.

props.quote: A Skill's SKILL.md is the whole program. Claude follows it exactly — reliable inside what's written, blind past its edge.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me: write me a SKILL.md with five short numbered steps for a repeatable task I do often. Then read it back to me, step by step, before you run anything — and follow only what's written, nothing else. Watch whether every action Claude takes matches a line in that file, and whether it stops the moment the steps run out. Liam, in for Bear.
